note: [L] uses the torus separation only through the threshold predicate YM.Extraction.Gaps.someFine, in physical units. For all pairs i != j it asks for an axis whose periodic distance is at least s, which is equivalent to sep_tor >= s. The lattice-unit pairwise distance YM.Lattice.separation (pdist of the difference) is related to it by Gaps.gridSeparation. [L] has no named quantity for the minimum over pairs.

snippet.text:
def someFine {n : ℕ} (p : ℕ) (s : ℝ) (x : Points n) := ∀ i j, i≠j → ∃ a,
    off S p (distances x i j a) s

proof_context.conclusion: someFine p s x: for every pair i != j some axis a has physical coordinate difference at distance at least s from every multiple of the period length, i.e. min over pairs of the torus sup-distance is at least s; allFine requires this on every axis.
